title: Eat and learn your way through Barcelona
text: This was such a great experience and am so glad that we found this tour when we were planning our trip through Madrid and Barcelona. Our guide Olga was so so nice and had a lot of historical insights to share while we did our walking tour. This was the only tour we signed up for during our trip, so we learned a lot of really great context while walking and then got excellent things to eat at the food stops. title: Best Barcelona Guide!
text: Stephanie was a wealth of information! Kind, helpful, organized and fun! We learned more from her than any other guide from other tours. Very knowledgeable of the area and has a nice connection with the locals. Great history knowledge but not overwhelming. She wanted to be sure we had a good experience. She went out of her way to show us more than required. Great experience!!

title: Food and culture of Barcelona
text: My partner and I had a wonderful time on our food and culture tour with Montse!  She is full of knowledge, polite, and fun.  We had the chance to try food at different markets and learn about the city as we walked around. Having Montse’s insight was so helpful as she knew the best places to go.  It was clear she has developed good relationships with the vendors.  Her background in art and history were evident as she shared about Barcelona. title: The Full Montse! A Genuine Catalan Tour
text: Montse was amazing. She spent so much time with us and took us explaining her Catalan culture and we visited her favorite places. We were stuffed with both food, drink and knowledge by the end of the almost 4 hours!

title: Best Guide!
text: We were delighted with the walk. The Montserrat guide is extremely nice and led us through really amazing places, always sharing rich and full of details. She was very careful with us and expressed herself in a clear way, that even those who do not master Spanish or English can follow without effort. So far, this was undoubtedly the most striking tour we have ever made.
author: jayzab2022

title: Loveliest guide in Barcelona called Montserrat
text:
We had a food tour around Barcelona with a guide called Montserrat. She was super lovely and very informative. Not only did we eat really well but she also gave us lots of information about Barcelona which we appreciated. So it was like hitting two birds with one stone. We ate some really good dishes at the market. Our most favourite was a dish called fricandò. She even sent us the recipe later which was very sweet of her. 
We really felt like a friend is taking us around the city. Didn’t feel forced or structured. 
Thank you Discover Spain and Montserrat. We highly recommend!

title: Recommended!

author: Jorunn82

title: Spectacular tour
text:
Tour 100% recommended.
Our guide Montserrat made us a personalized tour. He explained both markets and we tried spectacular tapas in both. He also explained the Gothic quarter and even thanks to it we were able to enter emblematic buildings for free. We ended the tour by sampling a cake that received the first prize in 2025 in the Born neighborhood. And, if that weren’t enough, it also gave us tips for visiting more places in Barcelona. Nice to meet someone so professional!!
author: Lour_vlnc
